duration.text: The MBBS at Dali University is a 6 Years long program for international students, taught in English.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 150 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 3194 USD/per year ￥ 23000 CNY/per year

materials.text: 1. Photocopy of valid passport With photo, passport number &expiration date and name included. 2. Passport-sized photo A passport-sized photo taken recently of the applicant. 3. Transcript of High School and Diploma 4. No-Crime Certificate

requirements.text: Be in good health condition, which accords with the Health Standard for International Students stipulated by the China Education Department;Have certain English language ability;Have good moral character and obey the laws and regulations of the Chinese government and regulations of the university. Respect Chinese social customs and habits.
